name: Kyoto
description: Ancient capital of Japan renowned for thousands of classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, and traditional wooden houses.

name: Florence
description: The cradle of the Renaissance, celebrated worldwide for its iconic Duomo, Uffizi Gallery masterworks, and exquisite Tuscan culinary traditions.

name: Banff
description: Stunning alpine resort town situated within Banff National Park, featuring glacier-fed turquoise lakes, towering peaks, and pristine wilderness trails.

name: Santorini
description: Cycladic island famous for dramatic whitewashed cliffside villages, brilliant blue-domed churches, volcanic beaches, and legendary Aegean sunsets.

name: Cape Town
description: Cosmopolitan coastal metropolis flanked by the iconic Table Mountain, dramatic Atlantic coastlines, world-class vineyards, and rich history.

name: Queenstown
description: The adventure tourism capital of the Southern Hemisphere, framed by Lake Wakatipu and the dramatic Southern Alps.

name: Oaxaca
description: A vibrant cultural sanctuary acclaimed for its indigenous artisan crafts, colonial architecture, and deep culinary heritage including moles and mezcal.

name: Dubrovnik
description: The Pearl of the Adriatic, surrounded by massive 16th-century stone walls encircling a pedestrianized marble-paved Old Town.

name: Bali
description: Indonesian island paradise known for forested volcanic mountains, iconic rice paddies, beaches, coral reefs, and profound spiritual traditions.

name: Prague
description: The City of a Hundred Spires, boasting Gothic churches, the medieval astronomical clock, Charles Bridge, and centuries of architectural splendor.

name: Petra
description: Remarkable archaeological wonder carved directly into vibrant pink sandstone cliffs by the Nabataean civilization over two millennia ago.

name: Reykjavik
description: World's northernmost capital, acting as the gateway to geothermal hot springs, volcanic landscapes, dramatic glaciers, and the Northern Lights.
